title: Lychee Sunset Martini
summary: A pink, citrus-bright cocktail with a delicate lychee finish.
ingredients:
2 oz vodka
1 oz lychee liqueur
0.5 oz lime juice
0.5 oz simple syrup
2–3 drops PURE Lychee Flavor
Fresh lychee, to garnish
method:
Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake until chilled.
Strain into a martini glass and garnish with fresh lychee.

title: Cinnamon Roll Old Fashioned
summary: Warm cinnamon, maple and bourbon for a slow-sipping classic.
ingredients:
2 oz bourbon
0.5 oz maple syrup
2 dashes aromatic bitters
8–10 drops PURE Cinnamon Roll Flavor
Charred cinnamon stick and orange twist, to garnish
method:
Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Garnish with cinnamon and an orange twist.

title: Honey-Nutella Mousse Cake
summary: Chocolate, hazelnut and honey in a chilled, creamy creation.
ingredients:
CRUST
1½ cups chocolate cookie crumbs
½ cup melted butter
MOUSSE
1 cup Nutella
1 cup heavy cream
2 tsp PURE Honey Flavor
½ cup whipped cream
TOPPING
Chocolate ganache, toasted hazelnuts and honey
method:
Combine crust ingredients, press into a pan and chill.
Whip heavy cream to soft peaks.
Fold in Nutella and PURE Honey Flavor.
Gently fold in whipped cream.
Pour over the crust and chill for 4 hours.
Top with ganache, hazelnuts and honey.

title: PURE Peach Graham Cake
summary: Layers of peach, cream and graham for an easy homemade treat.
ingredients:
1 pack graham crackers
2 cups heavy cream
1 can condensed milk
2–3 fresh peaches, thinly sliced
1 tsp PURE Peach Flavor
½ cup melted butter
method:
Mix crushed grahams and butter for the crust.
Whip cream, condensed milk and PURE Peach Flavor until stiff.
Layer crust, cream and peach slices in a dish. Repeat.
Chill for at least 4 hours.
Slice and enjoy!
